errors.description: adc_sample_q is a multi-bit value produced in adc_clk and sampled directly in dsp_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
sample_ready_pulse_q is a one-cycle adc_clk pulse consumed directly in dsp_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
sample_ready_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample dsp_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in dsp_event_o.
range_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector range_mode_q before decoding in dsp_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
adc_rst_n is used as data inside dsp_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
cfg_snapshot_q combines adc_clk payload state with dsp_clk status state in cfg_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
